title: Balanced Bahama Veggie Bowl
subtitle: with Avocado, Vegan Feta and Lime
description: This nourishing bowl of goodness is completely plant-based. Tumble roasted veggies, avocado and creamy vegan feta over a nutritious grain blend for healthy eating that's utterly delish.

steps.text: Cook grain blend: Make sure your avocado is ripe before starting (see Kitchen hack). Preheat the oven to 210C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Add the grain blend and cook for 20-22 mins until tender. Drain.
Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, cut the unpeeled sweet potatoes and capsicum into 2cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove.

Roast veggies: Put the garlic, 1 tsp cumin and coriander spice blend and 2 tsp olive oil in a large bowl. Add the sweet potato and capsicum and toss to coat. Put on the lined tray and roast for 22-25 mins until golden and tender.

Dress grain blend: Finely grate the zest of half the lime, then juice the half. Cut the remaining lime into wedges. Put the grain blend in a large bowl. Add the lime zest, lime juice, ¼ tsp cumin and coriander spice blend and 1 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and gently toss to coat.

Serve up: Cut the avocado into 1cm chunks. Divide the grain blend mixture, roasted veggies and avocado among bowls. Crumble over the vegan feta and serve with the lime wedges for squeezing over. Enjoy!
Kitchen hack: To speed up the ripening process, put the avocado in a brown paper bag with a banana and close loosely, then leave on the kitchen bench for a day or two.
